rationale: [recovery-agent diagnosis via claude-opus-5[1m]] remedy_history shows transient_retry already spent 2x on PROCESS_FAILED@equilibration with unchanged params; a third blind retry is ruled out. Evidence: all three failures occur only in the 625 K NVT anneal (attempt-0001 anneal_heat ~997k steps and attempt-0003 anneal_hold ~268k steps: cudaErrorIllegalAddress abort in the KOKKOS binary; attempt-0002 anneal_heat ~952k steps: 'ERROR: Out of range atoms - cannot compute PPPM' at pppm_kokkos.cpp:1150). Onset is stochastic (attempt-0003's anneal_heat completed cleanly), thermo at 1000-step resolution shows no precursor (T ~605-625 K, stable PE), and all earlier stages (minimize..npt_densify_hold, <=500 K) passed in every attempt. No other run under data/ has either signature. Root cause is ambiguous between two hypotheses requiring different fixes: (1) GPU 1 hardware/driver fault -- all three chains (run_state.json 37893711/49363cbc/02ba54ec) ran on gpu_ids=1, and Xid/ECC logs could not be checked from this session; (2) high-T integration instability of explicit-H PCFF/class2 PEO at dt_fs=1.0, weakened by PEEK_3 completing a 1M-step Kokkos-PPPM PCFF anneal_hold at 850 K with dt 1 fs. Neither contract lever is safe to pick blind: dt_fs=0.5 addresses only hypothesis 2, changes a POXI-calibrated constant, and (step counts appear fixed) halves simulated time per stage while doubling Tg-sweep cost; lowering annealing_T_high_K breaks the documented polymer_rules coupling to md_tg_ceiling_K=600 (_annealing_T_high_K_note: the anneal ceiling must clear the Tg sweep top by one cool block), so it needs a coordinated two-key change (e.g. md_tg_ceiling_K back to 440, which _md_tg_ceiling_K_note says was sized for PEO) whose downstream constraints are unverified. With one escalation left, a wrong guess re-burns ~1 GPU-h and ends the run. Human action: check GPU 1 for Xid/ECC errors (journalctl -k | grep -i xid; nvidia-smi -q -d ECC). As a discriminator, rerun anneal_hold from attempt-0003/work/anneal_heat/anneal_heat_out.restart on GPU 0. If it crashes there too, treat the cause as physics and apply dt_fs=0.5, or lower annealing_T_high_K together with md_tg_ceiling_K. If it survives on GPU 0, the cause is GPU 1: retry unchanged on another GPU.
